global_design_rules.shadows: Text shadows for glowing effects, no soft box-shadows. Use sharp 1px borders instead.
global_design_rules.transitions: Instant or stepped/glitchy transitions. Avoid overly smooth modern eases unless for CRT fade.
global_design_rules.surface_strategy: Terminal Window Layout: Flat black backgrounds with 1px high-contrast green or white borders.
global_design_rules.accessibility: High contrast green/white on pitch black.

primary_heading.family: JetBrains Mono, VT323, or Space Mono

visual_enhancers.crt_scanlines: MANDATORY: Fixed fullscreen pointer-events-none overlay with repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 4px) and subtle flicker animation.
visual_enhancers.glitch_effect: Text shadows (e.g., 2px 0 red, -2px 0 blue) and brief keyframe translations for critical alerts.
visual_enhancers.redaction_bars: Use [REDACTED] for interactive un-redacting, or purely solid blocks (█████).
visual_enhancers.typing_animation: Use framer-motion or pure CSS step animations to reveal text sequentially in boot sequences and terminal outputs.

components.buttons: Flat design. border border-green-500 text-green-500 bg-black px-4 py-2 hover:bg-green-500 hover:text-black transition-colors duration-75 uppercase text-sm tracking-wider. Add terminal 'click' sound on click.
components.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-green-500/50 focus:border-green-500 outline-none text-green-400 font-mono py-1 px-2. No rounded corners.
components.panels_windows: Draggable/resizable dashboard widgets. Must have a header bar (bg-green-500/10 border-b border-green-500/50 p-1 flex justify-between items-center text-xs) and content area (p-4 border border-green-500/30 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm).
components.terminal_console: A specific widget with a log history array and an input line (prefixed with 'OWL-SYS> ').
components.data_table: Case files list. border-collapse, border border-green-500/20. th and td should have 1px borders. Text size xs or sm.

boot_sequence.concept: Full screen overlay on first load. Prints 'BE INFORMED. BE ENLIGHTENED.', 'Connecting to Site-416...', 'Verifying Clearance...'. Fake loading bar [||||||||  ]. Followed by fake login screen.
boot_sequence.behavior: Unmounts or hides after successful fake login.

login_screen.concept: Centered terminal prompt asking for 'Operative ID' and 'Clearance Code'. Flashes red 'ACCESS DENIED' on initial false attempts, then allows entry on submit.

dashboard_layout.concept: Post-login. A masonry or grid of draggable/resizable terminal windows (Incident Logs, Live Operations Map, Command Terminal, Personnel).
dashboard_layout.tools_to_use: react-rnd (if adding package) or framer-motion drag constraints, or fallback to a static CSS grid with a 'drag handle' aesthetic if draggable is too complex.

case_files_crud.concept: Form to submit anomalous reports, saves to localStorage. Fields: Title, Operative Name, Date, Classification (Safe/Euclid/Keter/OWL Levels), Description.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark background with white geometric shapes (Use for classified document backgrounds or glitch overlays)
Creepy dark silhouette in snow (Use for 'The Messenger' anomalous entity file or Rival dossiers)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the black, green, and red color scheme. Do not introduce modern gradients, glassmorphism (unless very subtle dark blur), or rounded corners.
Implement the CRT scanline effect using pure CSS on a fixed overlay.
Ensure the Boot Sequence is highly immersive, using intervals or timeouts to print text sequentially.
For draggable dashboard windows, consider using 'framer-motion' with drag constraints or a dedicated library like 'react-rnd'. If native drag is built, ensure z-index management on active windows.
Use 'lucide-react' for minimal icons (Terminal, Shield, FileText, Skull, Cpu).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Store Case Files in localStorage under the key 'owl_case_files'. Pre-populate it with 2-3 creepy lore entries (e.g., about The Messenger).
